First day of week must be Monday, Saturday or Sunday
Use DateTime.monday, DateTime.saturday or DateTime.sunday if unsure.

First day of week must be between 1 and 7 (inclusive)
Use DateTime.monday ~ DateTime.sunday if unsure.
The DateTimeRange start and end must be on the same day.
The animation duration must be less or equal to the page trigger delay.
The id of the event must be set before removing it.
The id of the event must not be set manually.
Week difference is not a whole number, this should not happen and is a bug
